market_definition: ADVANCED WOUND CARE PRODUCTS - advanced wound dressings (bordered and non-bordered foam, alginate and fiber, hydrocolloid, hydrogel, collagen, antimicrobial and film dressings); wound therapy devices (negative pressure wound therapy systems, pressure relief and offloading devices, hyperbaric oxygen therapy equipment, electrical stimulation devices); biologics and regenerative wound care (skin substitutes, growth-factor products); wound closure and adjunctive products (adhesive closure, sealants, hemostats, compression); wound cleansing and debridement products. For chronic and acute wounds (diabetic foot, pressure and venous ulcers, burns, surgical wounds), supplied to hospitals, clinics and homecare. Manufacturers include Smith+Nephew, Solventum (3M), Molnlycke, B. Braun and Coloplast. EXCLUDE basic gauze, cotton and plain bandage traders and general pharmacy retailers.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
